name: Humanoid work robot
description: Generic white bipedal work robot with graphite joint gaps, smoked visor and a green chest status lamp. 47 meshes, 7052 triangles, 4 materials, no textures. Five animation clips (Walk, Idle, Carry, Handoff, Service) rotate the ten named parts about their pivots; Carry and Handoff hold both hands on the sides of a FOUP-sized box at the foupCarry / foupHandoff locators.
brief: Foundry Floor P2 humanoid-work-robot: generic Terafab-inspired bipedal work robot, 0.40 (X) x 0.62 (Z) x 1.73 (Y) m, feet on Y=0, facing +X. Ten rigid parts (torso, head, armLeft/Right, forearmLeft/Right, legLeft/Right, shinLeft/Right), locators foupCarry (0.32,0.92,0) and foupHandoff (0.60,0.92,0), clips Walk 1.1 s, Idle 4 s, Carry 1.1 s, Handoff 3 s, Service 3 s. Materials robot-white, robot-graphite, glass-smoked, status-green. No brand, livery, logo, text or real-product likeness.
